summary_zh: FilmCraft 是一款用纯 Rust 从零编写的开源非线性视频编辑器，支持剪辑、调色、特效、音频、字幕与导出，内置自研 H.264、HEVC、ProRes、AAC 等编解码器，可原生运行于 macOS、Windows、Linux，也可在浏览器通过 WebAssembly 使用。
audience_zh: 适合需要跨平台非线性剪辑与调色的视频创作者、剪辑师和调色师，也适合关注纯 Rust 实现、自研编解码器及希望用 AI 代理精确驱动编辑操作的开源开发者与技术用户。

evidence.quote: FilmCraft: An open-source, nonlinear video editor written from scratch in pure Rust
An open-source, modern non-linear video editing workflow: native on macOS, Windows and Linux, and in the browser via WebAssembly.

FilmCraft is a professional non-linear editor: familiar panels, workspaces, tools and shortcuts, so your hands already know where everything is. Underneath, it is new from the bitstream up.
